contracts.claim: Subagent receipts remain advisory, normalize role/status/confidence and bound prompts, inspected paths and finding evidence.
Suite averages, pass rate and preset count exactly reflect supplied observed rows, including the empty suite.
Successful suite artifact writing returns paths whose JSON preserves all input evidence and whose human report lists every preset.
Skill retrieval returns only the highest ranked overlapping skills within the requested slice, or the ranked defaults when no token overlaps.
Compiled skill plans bind normalized behavior vectors, executable gates/scopes and instruction availability receipts to a canonical SHA-256; available text alone does not claim enforced behavior.
Project SKILL.md definitions take precedence over same-id personal guidance, with one discoverable row per skill ID.
Task skill briefs preserve mission attribution, bounded selections, permissions, relevant failure/success history and compact descriptions rather than embedding full instruction text.
Skill slice feedback persists bounded attributed rows; high-loss slices repair and stagnant low-loss slices may branch without manufacturing improvement.
Repeated zero-lift low-loss slices remain review/stagnant and are ineligible for promotion; feedback cannot bypass human promotion review.
A pending plan step remains the first bounded continuation suggestion and generated suggestions contain no duplicates.
Repository metadata projects nonnegative file counts and Boolean project/readme presence with no extra fields.
Every requested verification command has one explicit outcome; high-risk commands return blocked/126 and actual child timeouts return timeout/124 with diagnostics.
Pytest command spelling uses the selected Python executable; unrelated command text remains intact.

Default verification command declarations reflect project/source/test/package metadata and actual interpreter availability, with an explicit fallback when unavailable. Discovery never executes the declared verification commands.
Heavy builds require gateway and time; browser verification additionally requires an operator. Absence cannot silently grant capacity.
Changed-file lists are bounded and unique, required/gated counts match real steps and capacity-gated work remains skipped.
Syntax, targeted, backend and UI receipt statuses reflect observed exits/missing files or supplied interaction outcomes. Backend commands stop on first failure; absent evidence stays skipped.

Support archives preserve exact published hashes and the five-member allowlist; exclude raw prompts/logs/credentials, refuse hostile secret-shaped metadata and bound job/log inspection. External linked roots disclose no bytes.

Performance evidence validates configuration, source assets, age, build/config/digest binding, measured provenance, sample limits and recomputed finite nonnegative metrics. Aggregate status remains fail-closed and local passing evidence cannot grant promotion; diagnostics hide private paths.
Generated Python/TypeScript bindings have canonical LF bytes, deterministic schema ordering and resolvable language types; Git autocrlf checkout preserves committed generated bytes.
Generator receipts faithfully report compared/written on-disk bytes and hashes for both language outputs.
Schema generation rejects lossy keywords/literals with precise pointers and keeps closed empty, open JSON, unconstrained JSON and scalar literal types distinct.
SDK manifest builders preserve bridge identity, requested task/context/action semantics and declared approval requirements.

SDK launch/install/profile planning never acquires execution or activation authority. CLI JSON inputs must be objects; untrusted publisher packages remain blocked and declared surfaces remain unavailable without live readiness.

Every SDK HTTP request preserves its explicit destination/POST/payload and includes a session cookie only when requested. Responses must be JSON objects. Local protocol proof preserves runtime routes, application context and delivery attribution.
Video metadata binds exact source bytes and model-facing stream/audio dimensions to real FFprobe observations.

Every completed video digest returns counts matching its durable manifest, hash-bound timestamped frames and a matching storyboard; real scene duplicate suppression and extracted audio are checked at startup.
Video-analysis action proposals select video.digest with the exact recognized source path.

Every staging path decision rejects private memory/browser-profile candidates while preserving redacted evidence candidates. This proof only evaluates path metadata, never performs snapshot or NAS transfer.
Runtime-update metadata parsing only reports the package literally named in a global npm @latest command; it never performs the update.
Skill creation validates scoped IDs and writes complete SKILL.md, interface metadata and hash-bound initial history. Failed creation preserves prior content and leaves no partial skill folder.

Reviewed skill saves preserve exact backups, validate before replacement, bind source hashes and increment a single persisted revision. Invalid or unchanged writes preserve prior bytes/history; explicit personal roots remain separate from project history.
Skill catalogs expose bounded evolution history, revisions and useful usage without treating usage as trusted promotion; human review remains required.
Resident UI semantic identity ignores focus/hover presentation noise while preserving durable node identity, role, value, actions and quantized bounds.
Every resident graph replacement stamps all nodes with its new revision and binds returned changes to the exact current semantic hash and node set.
Semantic graph diffs return each actual added/changed/removed identity exactly once.
UI graph search returns sorted bounded nodes matching exact/substring role/name/id queries or free text; it never returns a nonmatching control.
Compact UI deltas retain graph revision/hash and every bounded changed identity without returning a full tree.
Playwright/CDP AX payload normalization preserves stable actionable role/source identity and editable values, omits presentation noise and exposes no disabled click action.
Every compact UI result explicitly omits trees and binds its revision, semantic hash and node count to the resident graph.
Stale revision/hash UI actions reject before graph mutation; startup proves actual no-page failure without fabricating a browser interaction.
Native/progressive UI registration installs every compact tool once with callable/describable handlers; progressive search omits full schemas and describe supplies them.
